title: SKE Crystal Plus Bora Bora Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Bora Bora flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods combine the bright, zesty tang of grapefruit with a sweet-sharp medley of mixed berries, delivering a perfectly balanced, fruity vape bursting with vibrant, tropical and berry notes. Refreshing, tangy, and sweet, this flavour is ideal for vapers seeking a vibrant, uplifting all-day vape. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods offer the same premium vaping experience as the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposables, with the added benefit of being a more practical, sustainable option. Compact, portable, and convenient, they’re perfect for on-the-go vaping. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, which provides a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine satisfaction. The integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil ensures excellent flavour delivery and a consistently satisfying MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) vaping experience. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
